rationale.conceptual: The physical and mechanical property formulas are well-established and the required parameters (oxide densities, dissociation energies, ionic radii) are available from literature references provided. The radiation shielding coefficients are obtained by querying an existing online database (Phy-X/PSD) or using a standard library. There is no novel method or deep domain expertise needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential but independent computation steps (physical properties, mechanical moduli, mass attenuation coefficients) each producing a CSV file. The code involves straightforward scripting with standard libraries; no complex data fetching, tooling, or orchestration is required.

The method is standard, the pipeline is simple, and no heavy computation or novel algorithm is involved.
